exposure.needed: whether users create applications whose destination sets both name and server through the Argo CD UI

consequence.statement: Applications whose destination sets both name and server, which the UI previously could not add, can now be added through the UI; no operator action is required.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 fixes the UI bug that prevented adding an application whose destination sets both name and server, so such applications can now be added through the UI.
